campaign_policy: run one attempt at a time and inspect its receipt before deciding whether to continue; never exceed 20 attempts
cancellation: provider request ceiling reached before transport
unresolved request admission, event stream, or exact run/job identity
unexpected access to the private verifier

cost.basis: user authorized up to 20 Muse Spark 1.3 runs without a budget concern
cost.unavailable_usd_treatment: record unknown; do not infer zero

route_restriction: Muse Spark 1.3 through the existing CodeGG opencode_go adapter only; no external proposer or other model route
